title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Free of… (CVE-2026-80264)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a Free of Memory not on the Heap vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged attacker with local access to potentially cause a denial of service. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity. The CVSS score is low, reflecting limited impact and high attack complexity.
